scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of universal bound and hypercube asymptotics supplied; finite exact-rational tests are supplementary, not a proof by enumeration. Prior-work comparison is qualified and not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple metric graphs with strictly positive constant mass density on each edge; continuous real affine functions with one element per edge. The hypercube deficit rate does not apply to arbitrary graph sequences. Earlier equivalent derivations remain possible.
title: Sharp dimension-free stability of metric-graph linear spline projection
